name: documents
description: Better document reading: PDF page pictures in the Files view and for OCR (pypdfium2), PDF tables (pdfplumber), and more formats through Microsoft MarkItDown (.xls, Outlook .msg and others). LOKI already reads PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, e-mail, EPUB and HTML without it.
license: pypdfium2: Apache-2.0 / BSD-3-Clause; pdfplumber: MIT; MarkItDown: MIT
install: pip install pypdfium2 pdfplumber markitdown (the Install button does it)
